message: Fix online-softmax O rescaling: interleave PV mma inside the per-tile loop so o_frag *= exp(m_prev-m_new) multiplies already-accumulated O (was multiplying zeros since PV ran after all 4 tiles). Add OOB key masking for seq_len % 64 != 0. FA2-style sm_86 wmma m16n16k16 kernel, cp.async double-buffered K/V, padded smem, GQA support. 31.8 TFLOPS vs 2.37 seed.

Shrink smem to 39,936 B (BLOCK_N 64->32, single-buffered K/V) so 2 blocks fit per SM: occupancy 8.3%->16.4%, latency-bound kernel speeds up 32.8->~44 TFLOPS. Also fix load_tile row count (Q needs BLOCK_M rows, not BLOCK_N).

BLOCK_N 32->16 (smem 39,936->29,184 B) + launch_bounds(128,3): 3 blocks/SM instead of 2 -> 12 warps in flight (occupancy 16.4%->24.3%), latency-bound kernel +11.5% (43.95->48.98 quick, all configs +10-13%). 168 regs, negligible spill.

Feed softmaxed P to the PV matmul directly from registers: wmma m16n16k16 matrix_a row_major layout == accumulator layout, so P converts in-place to bf16 and skips the 3,072 B shared-memory round-trip (writes + ldmatrix per tile). Also parametrize load_tile with an explicit pitch. smem 29,184->26,112 B.
Q/O straight from gmem registers (drop smem staging), BLOCK_N 16->32 (halves tile iterations/barriers), conditional O-rescale skipped when running max unchanged
Causal block-order reversal: launch the heaviest (latest) query-row blocks first so all SMs start their long causal tile chains immediately (LPT scheduling); improves causal tail latency.
